dirs.direction: Coastal editorial: warm sand paper, a high-contrast serif headline, and hairline rules that read like a printed weekly almanac
Swiss-style grid: a strict 12-column layout, one saturated accent color, bold grotesque type, and data-forward modules
Organic tidepool: soft blob shapes, layered translucent gradients, rounded friendly UI, and playful micro-motion
Dark ops console: near-black background, monospaced labels, glowing status indicators, and a terminal-like feel
Neo-brutalist: heavy black borders, offset hard shadows, system fonts, and loud flat color blocks

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tidepool · Plan your week together</title>
<meta name="description" content="Tidepool helps small teams plan their week together, in one shared, playful board.">
<style>
  /* ---------- Tokens ---------- */
  :root {
    --sand: #fbf5ea;
    --foam: #f2fbf8;
    --mist: #e6f6f3;
    --lagoon: #0e4a5a;
    --teal: #2a9d8f;
    --sea: #7fd1c4;
    --coral: #ff7f6b;
    --peach: #ffb89f;
    --kelp: #9ad98e;
    --lilac: #b8a6f2;
    --sun: #ffd76a;
    --ink: #12343b;
    --ink-soft: #4b6b72;
    --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
    --glass-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
    --line: rgba(18, 52, 59, 0.10);
    --shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) inset, 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(14, 74, 90, .28);
    --radius-lg: 32px;
    --radius-md: 22px;
    --radius-sm: 14px;
    --font: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);
    --ease-soft: cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1);
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--font);
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--sand);
    line-height: 1.55;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  img, svg { display: block; }
  a { color: inherit; }
  h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.12; margin: 0 0 .5em; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  p { margin: 0 0 1em; }
  .wrap { width: min(1160px, 92vw); margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; }

  /* ---------- Organic background layers ---------- */
  .tide-bg {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 90% -10%, rgba(127, 209, 196, .45), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 600px at -10% 40%, rgba(184, 166, 242, .28), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 700px at 60% 110%, rgba(255, 184, 159, .32), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--foam) 0%, var(--sand) 70%);
  }

  .blob {
    position: absolute; pointer-events: none; z-index: -1;
    filter: blur(2px);
    animation: morph 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate, drift 22s ease-in-out infinite;
    opacity: .9;
  }
  .blob.teal {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(127,209,196,.85), rgba(42,157,143,.35));
    width: 520px; height: 480px; top: -120px; right: -120px;
  }
  .blob.lilac {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(214,204,255,.95), rgba(184,166,242,.35) 70%);
    width: 420px; height: 380px; top: 35%; left: -140px;
    animation-duration: 18s, 28s; animation-delay: -4s, -9s;
  }
  .blob.peach {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,215,190,.95), rgba(255,127,107,.30));
    width: 360px; height: 340px; bottom: 8%; right: 6%;
    animation-duration: 16s, 24s; animation-delay: -7s, -3s;
  }
  .blob.kelp {
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(154,217,142,.55), rgba(127,209,196,.2));
    width: 300px; height: 280px; top: 60%; left: 45%;
    animation-duration: 20s, 30s;
  }

  @keyframes morph {
    0%   { border-radius: 42% 58% 70% 30% / 45% 45% 55% 55%; }
    33%  { border-radius: 60% 40% 35% 65% / 55% 40% 60% 45%; }
    66%  { border-radius: 35% 65% 50% 50% / 40% 60% 45% 55%; }
    100% { border-radius: 58% 42% 38% 62% / 50% 55% 45% 50%; }
  }
  @keyframes drift {
    0%   { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0deg); }
    50%  { transform: translate3d(18px,-22px,0) rotate(6deg); }
    100% { transform: translate3d(-12px,14px,0) rotate(-4deg); }
  }

  .section-blobs { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }

  /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
  .btn {
    --bg: var(--lagoon);
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem;
    padding: .95rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 0;
    font: 600 1rem/1 var(--font); color: #fff; background: var(--bg);
    text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(14,74,90,.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
    transition: transform .35s var(--ease-bounce), box-shadow .35s var(--ease-soft);
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 18px 34px -12px rgba(14,74,90,.6); }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  .btn.ghost {
    --bg: transparent; color: var(--lagoon);
    background: var(--glass-strong); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(14,74,90,.16);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
  .btn.coral { --bg: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff9a86, var(--coral)); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(255,127,107,.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35); }
  .btn .ripple {
    position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; transform: scale(0);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.45); pointer-events: none;
    animation: ripple .7s var(--ease-soft) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes ripple { to { transform: scale(4); opacity: 0; } }
  .btn .arrow { transition: transform .35s var(--ease-bounce); }
  .btn:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(4px) rotate(-8deg); }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header.nav {
    position: sticky; top: 14px; z-index: 50;
    margin: 14px auto 0; width: min(1160px, 92vw);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: .6rem .6rem .6rem 1.1rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--glass-strong);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  }
  .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; animation: wobble 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes wobble { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05); } }
  .nav ul { display: flex; gap: .2rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  .nav ul a {
    display: block; padding: .55rem .9rem; border-radius: 999px;
    text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .95rem;
    transition: background .3s, color .3s;
  }
  .nav ul a:hover { background: rgba(42,157,143,.12); color: var(--lagoon); }
  .nav .btn { padding: .7rem 1.1rem; font-size: .92rem; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero { padding: 80px 0 60px; position: relative; }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.02fr 1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
    padding: .4rem .85rem .4rem .5rem; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--glass-strong); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -10px rgba(14,74,90,.4);
  }
  .eyebrow .dot {
    width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff, var(--sun) 40%, var(--coral));
    animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.18); } }
  h1.display {
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.4vw, 4.4rem);
    font-weight: 800; margin: 1.1rem 0 1rem; letter-spacing: -.035em;
  }
  h1.display .wave-word {
    display: inline-block; position: relative;
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--teal), var(--sea) 40%, var(--lilac) 85%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    padding-right: .08em;
  }
  .wave-word .letter { display: inline-block; animation: bob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .15s; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .45s; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .6s; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: .75s; }
  .wave-word .letter:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: .9s; }
  @keyframes bob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px); } }
  .lede { font-size: 1.14rem; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 34rem; }
  .cta-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .8rem; margin: 1.8rem 0 1.2rem; }
  .micro-proof { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .9rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .93rem; }
  .stack { display: flex; }
  .stack span {
    width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; margin-left: -10px;
    border: 3px solid var(--sand); display: grid; place-items: center;
    font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff;
  }
  .stack span:first-child { margin-left: 0; }

  /* Board mock */
  .board-wrap { position: relative; perspective: 1200px; }
  .board {
    position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 18px;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,.9), rgba(255,255,255,.55));
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    box-shadow: 0 40px 80px -40px rgba(14,74,90,.45), inset 0 1px 0 #fff;
    transform: rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-6deg);
    transition: transform .6s var(--ease-soft);
  }
  .board:hover { transform: rotateX(0) rotateY(0); }
  .board-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .board-head h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 0; }
  .board-head small { color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; }
  .chip {
    font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; padding: .35rem .7rem; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--mist); color: var(--teal);
  }
  .days, .row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px;
  }
  .days { font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .days div { padding-left: 6px; }
  .row { margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: stretch; }
  .who {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700;
  }
  .av {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 42% 58% 60% 40% / 50% 45% 55% 50%;
    display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 800;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    animation: morph 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .av.a { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), var(--sea)); }
  .av.b { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--coral), var(--peach)); }
  .av.c { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lilac), #8e7cdc); }
  .av.d { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--kelp), #5fae6b); }
  .cell {
    min-height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; padding: 5px;
    background: rgba(14,74,90,.04); border: 1.5px dashed rgba(14,74,90,.08);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; justify-content: flex-start;
  }
  .pill {
    all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: grab;
    padding: .38rem .55rem; border-radius: 12px; font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2;
    color: var(--ink);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(127,209,196,.9), rgba(127,209,196,.45));
    box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(14,74,90,.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);
    transition: transform .4s var(--ease-bounce), box-shadow .3s;
    animation: plop .7s var(--ease-bounce) both;
  }
  .pill:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-1.5deg); box-shadow: 0 12px 20px -10px rgba(14,74,90,.55); }
  .pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sun); outline-offset: 2px; }
  .pill.coral { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,184,159,.95), rgba(255,127,107,.55)); }
  .pill.lilac { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(214,204,255,.95), rgba(184,166,242,.55)); }
  .pill.kelp  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(200,241,190,.95), rgba(154,217,142,.55)); }
  .pill.sun   { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,240,180,.98), rgba(255,215,106,.6)); }
  @keyframes plop { from { transform: scale(.6); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } }

  .float-card {
    position: absolute; z-index: 3; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem;
    padding: .7rem .95rem .7rem .7rem; border-radius: 20px;
    background: var(--glass-strong); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -16px rgba(14,74,90,.45);
    font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; max-width: 240px;
  }
  .float-card .bubble {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #fff, var(--sea) 60%, var(--teal));
    color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; animation: bob 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .float-card small { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; font-size: .75rem; }
  .fc-1 { top: -26px; left: -36px; animation: bob 5.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .fc-2 { bottom: -28px; right: -22px; animation: bob 6.5s ease-in-out -2s infinite; }

  .hero-wave { display: block; width: 100%; height: 90px; margin-top: 40px; }

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section { position: relative; }
  .section { padding: 110px 0; }
  .kicker {
    display: inline-block; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: .8rem;
  }
  .section-head { max-width: 640px; margin-bottom: 56px; }
  .section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 2.9rem); font-weight: 800; }
  .section-head p { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .center { text-align: center; margin-inline: auto; }

  /* Feature cards */
  .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .card {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 34px 30px 36px;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--glass-strong), var(--glass));
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    transition: transform .5s var(--ease-bounce), box-shadow .5s var(--ease-soft);
  }
  .card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-.4deg); box-shadow: 0 30px 50px -22px rgba(14,74,90,.4); }
  .card::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; width: 180px; height: 180px; right: -60px; bottom: -70px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--c, rgba(127,209,196,.5)), transparent 70%);
    transition: transform .8s var(--ease-soft);
  }
  .card:hover::after { transform: scale(1.5) translate(-10px, -10px); }
  .card .icon {
    width: 66px; height: 66px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 22px;
    border-radius: 42% 58% 55% 45% / 48% 42% 58% 52%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c1), var(--c2));
    box-shadow: inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 12px 22px -12px rgba(14,74,90,.5);
    animation: morph 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .card:hover .icon svg { animation: spin-wiggle .9s var(--ease-bounce); }
  @keyframes spin-wiggle { 0% { transform: rotate(0); } 40% { transform: rotate(-14deg) scale(1.1); } 100% { transform: rotate(0); } }
  .card h3 { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .card p { color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0; }
  .card.f1 { --c: rgba(127,209,196,.7); --c1: #7fd1c4; --c2: #2a9d8f; }
  .card.f2 { --c: rgba(255,184,159,.8); --c1: #ffb89f; --c2: #ff7f6b; }
  .card.f3 { --c: rgba(184,166,242,.7); --c1: #c9bcff; --c2: #8e7cdc; }
  .card.f1 .icon, .card.f2 .icon, .card.f3 .icon { color: #fff; }

  /* Flow steps */
  .flow { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(127,209,196,.14) 30%, rgba(127,209,196,.14) 70%, transparent); }
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 28px; position: relative; }
  .steps::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10%; right: 10%; top: 44px; height: 3px; z-index: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal) 0 14px, transparent 14px 26px);
    opacity: .5; border-radius: 3px;
    animation: dash 1.4s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes dash { to { background-position: 26px 0; } }
  .step { position: relative; z-index: 1; text-align: center; padding: 0 12px; }
  .step .num {
    width: 88px; height: 88px; margin: 0 auto 22px; display: grid; place-items: center;
    border-radius: 46% 54% 40% 60% / 56% 44% 56% 44%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #fff, #e4f7f3 55%, #bfe9e1);
    font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -8px 14px rgba(42,157,143,.15), 0 18px 30px -16px rgba(14,74,90,.5);
    transition: transform .5s var(--ease-bounce);
  }
  .step:hover .num { transform: scale(1.12) rotate(8deg); }
  .step h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .step p { color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 300px; margin: 0 auto; }

  /* Quote */
  .quote-card {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden; max-width: 880px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;
    padding: 64px 56px; border-radius: 48px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14,74,90,.96), rgba(42,157,143,.92));
    color: #eafaf6; box-shadow: 0 40px 70px -40px rgba(14,74,90,.8);
  }
  .quote-card::before, .quote-card::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, rgba(255,255,255,.25), rgba(255,255,255,0) 65%);
    animation: morph 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  .quote-card::before { width: 260px; height: 260px; top: -90px; left: -70px; }
  .quote-card::after { width: 200px; height: 200px; bottom: -70px; right: -40px; animation-delay: -5s; }
  .quote-card blockquote { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.6vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; position: relative; z-index: 1; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .quote-card cite { font-style: normal; font-size: .96rem; opacity: .85; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .quote-card .big-q { font-size: 4.5rem; line-height: .5; display: block; color: var(--sun); margin-bottom: .4rem; }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 380px)); justify-content: center; gap: 28px; }
  .price {
    position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 40px 36px;
    background: var(--glass-strong); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform .5s var(--ease-bounce);
  }
  .price:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }
  .price.hot {
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ffffff, #fff1ea);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(255,127,107,.55), var(--shadow);
  }
  .price .tag {
    position: absolute; top: -14px; right: 28px; padding: .4rem .9rem; border-radius: 999px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sun), var(--peach)); font-weight: 800; font-size: .8rem;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -10px rgba(255,127,107,.8);
    animation: wiggle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes wiggle { 0%,90%,100% { transform: rotate(0); } 93% { transform: rotate(-6deg); } 96% { transform: rotate(5deg); } }
  .price h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .price .amount { font-size: 3.2rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin: .4rem 0; }
  .price .amount small { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .price ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 1.6rem 0 2rem; }
  .price li { padding: .55rem 0 .55rem 2rem; position: relative; color: var(--ink-soft); border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); }
  .price li::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 14px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 45% 55% 50% 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fff, var(--sea) 60%, var(--teal));
  }
  .price .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
  details {
    border-radius: 24px; padding: 4px 24px; background: var(--glass-strong);
    border: 1px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -18px rgba(14,74,90,.5);
    transition: background .4s, box-shadow .4s;
  }
  details[open] { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -22px rgba(14,74,90,.45); }
  summary {

<script>
  // Scroll reveal
  (function () {
    const els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { els.forEach(e => e.classList.add('in')); return; }
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((en) => {
        if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.14, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    els.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
  })();

  // Ripple on buttons
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ripple]').forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
      const size = Math.max(r.width, r.height);
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'ripple';
      span.style.width = span.style.height = size + 'px';
      span.style.left = (e.clientX - r.left - size / 2) + 'px';
      span.style.top = (e.clientY - r.top - size / 2) + 'px';
      btn.appendChild(span);
      setTimeout(() => span.remove(), 700);
    });
  });

  // Playful pills: click to hop to the next day in the same lane
  document.querySelectorAll('.board .row').forEach((row) => {
    row.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach((pill) => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const cell = pill.closest('.cell');
        const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('.cell'));
        const idx = cells.indexOf(cell);
        const next = cells[idx + 1] || cells[0];
        pill.style.animation = 'none';
        next.appendChild(pill);
        void pill.offsetWidth;
        pill.style.animation = '';
        pill.animate(
          [{ transform: 'scale(.85)' }, { transform: 'scale(1.08)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }],
          { duration: 500, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)' }
        );
      });
    });
  });
</script>
